title: Food, Drinks, and Restaurants
summary: Discuss food and drinks, ingredients, cooking, tastes, restaurant items, and confidently order and pay for a meal.

practice: Say the Bengali words for three items from food, drinks, and restaurants.
Read each phrase aloud, then repeat it without looking at the transliteration.
Create a new sentence by replacing one word in a lesson phrase.
notes: নেব literally means ‘will take’ and is natural when ordering.
টা marks a specific item in casual speech.
